prompt:
Extend this video in the same single, unbroken, continuous shot with absolutely no cuts, no dissolves, no cross-fades and no change of shot: every frame follows smoothly from the previous one, and the same tower, hill and city stay continuously visible in every frame.
The camera keeps rising, and over these 8 seconds its upward motion and a gentle forward glide gradually and smoothly speed up to a moderate, steady pace, keeping the tower near the center of the frame; there is no sideways motion. The tower slowly and evenly becomes larger in the frame, to about one and a third times its size at the start of these 8 seconds, while the forested hill and the amusement park slide down toward the bottom of the frame and the wide city and the mountains spread out behind the tower, with real depth parallax. The motion never pauses and never jerks.
The warm morning light stays almost the same, becoming only very slightly brighter: the same soft golden sunlight, the same pale sky and the same clouds.
The tower keeps exactly the same design throughout: a red and white lattice antenna on top, a small cap, an upper observation ring, angled support struts and a large main observation deck with horizontal bands of windows. The observation deck has no external cranes, arms, gondolas, lifts or scaffolding. The tower, buildings, roads, rides and trees stay rigid and never appear, disappear or change shape. Stable level horizon.
Photorealistic aerial footage of a real place: natural, true-to-life trees with individual leaves and varied shapes, sizes and shades of green; real building facades with real windows, balconies and rooftop details; real thin steel structures, rails and supports on the amusement park rides. Natural, unsharpened detail with soft, realistic edges and natural contrast; no painterly, oil-painting, illustrated or cartoon look, no outline halos, no over-sharpening, no HDR look. Clear, clean air with good visibility. No text, no logos, no aircraft or birds in the frame.
